sections.h1:
Designed and built by one team.
Live this quarter.
sections.lead: Webflow, Framer, and WordPress builds from the studio that designed them — no handoff, no agency-to-dev translation layer, no paying twice for the same alignment meeting.

sections.body: Radiant builds production websites in Webflow, Framer, and WordPress, including CMS setup, motion and interactions, and analytics. Because the same studio designs and builds, there is no handoff gap: what was designed is what ships. [PLACEHOLDER: name platforms you are certified or most experienced in, plus 2–3 built sites with launch dates.]

sections.label: No-code Development
sections.challenge: You need a professional website live this quarter, not six months from now. And you don't want to coordinate a separate design agency and dev shop, manage handoffs between them, and pay twice for alignment meetings.

cards.title: The build quietly redesigns the design
cards.body: Spacing drifts, states go missing, the animation gets dropped because it was hard. When the people who designed it also build it, none of that negotiation happens behind your back.

cards.title: The CMS is modelled for the launch, not the year
cards.body: Six months in, a new case study needs a developer. We model collections around the content you will keep publishing, then show your team how to use them.

cards.title: Analytics arrive after launch
cards.body: Events get bolted on once someone asks for a number. We instrument the conversion path during the build, so the first week of traffic is measurable.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.title: Pick the platform honestly
steps.body: We ask who maintains the site, how often it changes, and what it must integrate with. The answer decides Webflow, Framer, or WordPress — not our preference, and we will tell you when code is the better call.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.title: Build with the CMS first
steps.body: Collections and components before pages, so your content model survives growth. Motion and interactions are built in, not added as an afterthought.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.title: Launch, measure, hand over
steps.body: Redirects, performance pass, analytics, and a recorded walkthrough for your team. You own the project, the account, and the ability to change it without calling us.

sections.heading: Trusted by our partners
sections.name: Aaron D.
sections.quote: Radiant exceeded all our expectations! Design and animations quality are on top level.

cards.title: Webflow, Framer, or WordPress — which is right for us?
cards.body: Framer for speed and motion-heavy marketing sites; Webflow when you need a richer CMS and tighter control; WordPress when you have an existing content library, plugins, or an editorial team already trained on it.

cards.title: How long does a build take?
cards.body: A landing page builds in a few days once design is signed off. A full marketing site takes two to four weeks of build after design, depending on CMS complexity and motion.

cards.title: What does it cost to run afterwards?
cards.body: Platform subscriptions plus hosting, typically [PLACEHOLDER: monthly range]. We list the real running cost before you choose a platform, including the plan tier your CMS actually needs.

cards.title: Do we own the site?
cards.body: Completely. The project lives in your account on your billing from day one. We work inside it as collaborators, so there is nothing to transfer and nothing held hostage.

cards.title: Can you maintain it for us?
cards.body: Yes, on a monthly retainer covering updates, new pages, and performance. Plenty of clients take the handover and run it themselves — both are fine.

cards.title: Can you work from designs we already have?
cards.body: Yes. We will review them first and flag anything that will not survive contact with a real CMS or a real phone, then build.

sections.label: Next step
sections.challenge: Tell us your deadline, who will maintain the site, and what it has to integrate with. We will recommend a platform and a realistic launch date on the call — free, and useful even if you build elsewhere.
